home.description: My little corner of the internet
home.mainParagraph: Welcome to my little corner of the internet! I'm a university student who likes to make cool stuff. In particular I like to make cool stuff on my computer. I'm pretty good at Python and Javascript and I also know a few other languages. Take a look around the site and maybe let me know what you think, hopefully you find something interesting. Anyways so long, and thanks for visiting!

connect.mainParagraph: Wana do something crazy? Just ask, I'll probably say yes. Or, if you just feel like saying hi, that’s cool too. The best way to reach me is via email, which is listed below.

about.mainParagraph: I'm currently attending Memorial University of Newfoundland majoring in Computer Science. The main reason I chose Computer Science is because I just like making cool things. I've always been interested in programming and using computers to make things so it seemed like a natural next step. The first time I tried programming was in grade 6 but I really learned how it all works in grade 9. Ever since I've been learning more and making random stuff. Other than programming I got a few hobbies like hiking, reading, and a few sports. I also play a few games, usually RTS games or shooters.
